summary: Scrapbook editor: a raw vertical take becomes a short in the scrapbook style the user validated (every pause cut, captions word by word, the hook in two faces with a line on paper, real GIFs as polaroids in the middle of the screen, titles on ruled notebook scraps in a marker hand, die-cut stickers, the red marker, sections, real screens annotated, Hip Hop 02 under it, real paper sounds and the Motionix pack, -14 LUFS). Runs on the short-editor's engine.

prerequisites.label: The video engine (the short-editor skill's scripts)
prerequisites.hint: The scrapbook editor renders with the short editor's engine: keep both skills installed.

prerequisites.label: Rendering engine (node packages)
prerequisites.hint: Installed on first run by the engine's bootstrap.mjs.

prerequisites.label: Speech-to-text (Whisper, on your Mac's GPU)
prerequisites.hint: Installed on first run by the engine's bootstrap.mjs.

prerequisites.label: Swift compiler (finds the face: the GIFs and titles placed by it, the stickers around it)
GIPHY_API_KEY (the real reaction GIFs of the style)
prerequisites.hint: Free at developers.giphy.com: Create an App, pick API (not SDK). Without it: GIFs you drop in, or generated reaction pictures.
prerequisites.offer: The real reaction GIFs of this style need a free GIPHY key. It takes a minute.
prerequisites.does: Searches the real reaction GIFs the Scrapbook style puts in the middle of the screen.
prerequisites.without: GIFs you drop in, or generated reaction pictures.
prerequisites.cost: Free (developers.giphy.com). GIFs are for organic posts only.

prerequisites.label: GEMINI_API_KEY (illustrations and reaction pictures)
prerequisites.hint: Nano Banana 2, about $0.07 a picture. Without it: your own pictures and GIFs only.
prerequisites.does: Draws the Scrapbook illustrations and stickers (Nano Banana 2).
prerequisites.without: Your own pictures and GIFs only.
prerequisites.cost: About $0.07 a picture, billed by Google.

prerequisites.label: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY (your voice made better, a bonus)
prerequisites.hint: Your own ElevenLabs key: in the app, Settings › Connectors › Add key. Only for the bonus « Your voice made better » (ElevenLabs' voice isolator: the room's echo and the noise out of your take), billed by ElevenLabs per minute of sound.
prerequisites.offer: Your voice can be made better (the room's echo and the noise taken out) with an ElevenLabs key. Without one, the take's own sound is used.
